summary.text: Allison Russo is the Democratic nominee. She is a state representative from Upper Arlington who served as House Minority Leader from January 2022 to 2025 and sat on the Ohio Redistricting Commission. Before office she worked more than 20 years in health policy. Her campaign focuses on protecting ballot access, limiting partisan influence over election administration and opposing the removal of ballot drop boxes.

paragraphs.text: Russo holds a doctorate in public health in health policy from George Washington University, a master's degree in epidemiology from the University of Alabama at Birmingham, and a bachelor's degree from Mississippi University for Women.
She worked in health policy for more than 20 years before holding office, advising federal agencies and health systems, and has been policy research director at Kennell and Associates since 2010.
Russo was first elected to the Ohio House in 2018, took her seat in 2019, and won re-election to four terms.
She was House Minority Leader from 2022 until stepping down in 2025.
